signs.h2: Signs Your Sewer Line Needs Attention
signs.sub: Sewer line problems rarely fix themselves — and they get more expensive the longer they're ignored.

cards.title: Frequent Backups
cards.body: Multiple drains backing up at the same time, especially the lowest drain in the house.

cards.title: Sewage Odor Outside
cards.body: A persistent sewage smell in your yard, often near where the line runs.

cards.title: Soggy Or Sunken Yard
cards.body: Unexplained wet, soft, or sunken patches in your lawn above the sewer line.

cards.title: Slow Drains Everywhere
cards.body: Every drain in the house is slow at once — a strong sign the main line is affected.

compare.sub: Depending on the damage, you may not need to dig up your entire yard to fix it.

cards.title: Traditional Dig-And-Replace
items: Requires digging a trench along the damaged line
Disrupts landscaping, driveways, or hardscape
Often necessary for severely collapsed or misaligned pipe
Typically longer job timeline

cards.title: Trenchless Repair
items: Repairs or replaces the line with minimal digging
Preserves your yard, driveway, and landscaping
Often faster to complete
Great fit for cracks, root intrusion, and pipe lining

hydrojetting.title: Hydrojetting - Lincoln Plumbing & Rooter
hydrojetting.description: Professional hydrojetting in San Bernardino and the Inland Empire. Clear tree roots, grease buildup, and stubborn clogs with high-pressure water jetting. Licensed and insured.

hero.lede: Tree roots, grease buildup, and stubborn clogs that keep coming back — hydrojetting clears your lines completely, not just temporarily. Serving San Bernardino and the Inland Empire.

signs.sub: Regular snaking only breaks a hole through a clog — hydrojetting clears the entire line. Here's when it's the right call.

cards.title: Recurring Clogs
cards.body: The same drain keeps clogging no matter how many times it's been snaked.

cards.title: Tree Root Intrusion
cards.body: Roots have grown into your sewer line and are restricting or blocking flow.

cards.title: Grease Buildup
cards.body: Years of grease and buildup have narrowed your pipes from the inside out.

cards.title: Multiple Slow Drains
cards.body: Several drains in your home are slow at the same time — often a main line issue.

compare.sub: Both clear clogs — but only one clears the whole pipe.

cards.title: Snaking
items: Punches a hole through the clog
Leaves buildup on the pipe walls
Clogs often return within weeks or months
Good for a quick, minor blockage

cards.title: Hydrojetting
items: Scours the entire interior of the pipe
Removes grease, scale, and root intrusion completely
Longer-lasting results, fewer repeat calls
Ideal for recurring or severe clogs

cards.title: Camera Inspection
cards.body: We run a camera through the line first to confirm hydrojetting is the right fix.

cards.title: High-Pressure Jetting
cards.body: Our equipment blasts the full pipe interior clear — roots, grease, and buildup included.

cards.title: Confirm & Walk Through
cards.body: We re-inspect the line, confirm it's fully clear, and walk you through what we found.

cards.title: Camera-Verified
cards.body: We inspect before and after so you actually see the results, not just take our word for it.

signs.h2: Signs You Have A Hidden Leak
signs.sub: Hidden leaks waste water and cause damage long before they become visible — catching them early saves money and prevents bigger repairs.

cards.title: Unexplained High Bill
cards.body: Your water bill jumps with no change in usage — a classic sign of a hidden leak.

cards.title: Sound Of Running Water
cards.body: You hear water running when every fixture in the house is off.

cards.title: Damp Spots Or Mold
cards.body: Unexplained damp patches on walls, ceilings, or floors, or musty odors.

cards.title: Low Water Pressure
cards.body: A sudden drop in water pressure that wasn't there before.

compare.sub: Finding a leak the wrong way can cost you more than the leak itself.

cards.title: Guessing & Digging
items: Opening walls or floors hoping to find the source
Risk of unnecessary demolition and repair costs
No guarantee the actual leak gets found
Can take multiple attempts to locate

cards.title: Professional Leak Detection
items: Electronic listening equipment and moisture sensors pinpoint the source
Minimal to no unnecessary demolition
Confirms the exact location before any repair work starts
Faster, more accurate, and ultimately less costly
